hooks.name: Validate Pipeline After Task
hooks.description: Runs after a spec task completes. Executes the full test suite and then checks that every alert in sample_alerts.json has a corresponding entry in mock_responses.json. Catches dataset/mock drift that would cause silent failures during benchmark runs.

action.command:
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && python3 -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "---" && python3 -c "
import json, sys
alerts = json.load(open('data/sample_alerts.json'))
mocks  = json.load(open('data/mock_responses.json'))
alert_ids = {a['alert_id'] for a in alerts}
mock_ids  = {k for k in mocks if not k.startswith('_')}
missing   = alert_ids - mock_ids
if missing:
    print('FAIL: alerts missing from mock_responses.json:', sorted(missing))
    sys.exit(1)
print(f'OK: {len(alert_ids)} alerts, {len(mock_ids)} mock entries, no gaps')
"
